title: CVE-2026-124758 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the record data length of an IODWrite request to a non-user record index against the size of the record block header. The 32-bit length is reduced by the header size before it is passed to the record handlers, so a length smaller than the header underflows and the handlers receive a data length of about 65530. The fixed-size reads of the I&M and PDPort handlers can then read past the end of the session buffer. The result of the write is discarded. title: CVE-2026-124759 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 routes a received RTA alarm frame to an Application Relationship using only the destination alarm reference in the frame, without checking the source of the frame. A host with ADJACENT network access can abort an established Application Relationship with a single alarm ERROR frame, or deliver forged alarm notifications with chosen type, slot, subslot, USI and payload to the application.
title_vi: CVE-2026-124759 — P-Net trước 1

title: CVE-2026-124760 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 sets the alarm receiver state to waiting for confirmation before the data of a received alarm notification is parsed. If the parsing fails the state is not restored, and later alarm notifications of the same priority are discarded without acknowledge until the Application Relationship is released. The Application Relationship and the cyclic data exchange keep working. The attacker must be able to send an alarm notification in the context of an established Application Relationship and requires ADJACENT network access.
title_vi: CVE-2026-124760 — P-Net trước 1

title: CVE-2026-124761 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 copies the IP suite of a DCP Set request to the current and the non-volatile configuration, and starts saving it, before the state of the device is checked. If the request is refused, for example because an Application Relationship is active, the configuration is not restored and is still saved. After a restart the device uses the refused address, and may not answer the controller or may use its address. A host with ADJACENT network access can use this while an Application Relationship is active.

summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 finds the RPC session of a received PDU by its activity UUID only, and a reject, fault or cancel PDU for the session aborts the Application Relationship, without checking that the PDU is the answer to a call of the device or where it comes from. A host with ADJACENT network access that has observed the activity UUID of the connection, which is sent in clear in every RPC request, can abort the Application Relationship with one PDU. It also allocates a session for an unknown activity UUID and changes the address stored for an existing session.

title: CVE-2026-127122 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the number of MCR request blocks in a Connect request against the number of multicast communication relations that an Application Relationship has room for (PNET_MAX_MC_CR, 1 by default). Each further block is written past the end of the array, into the rest of the Application Relationship and, with more blocks, into the following one. The written data comes from the request. No established Application Relationship is needed, and the attacker requires ADJACENT network access. Builds with PNET_OPTION_MC_CR disabled are not affected.

title: CVE-2026-127124 — P-Net before 1
summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 keeps the RPC session that is allocated for a fragment of a request with an unknown activity UUID, without a timeout, when the rest of the request never arrives. A session that does not get an Application Relationship is also kept after the response. Repeated fragments or requests with different activity UUIDs exhaust the available sessions, one UDP packet per session. Once they are exhausted the device no longer answers a Connect request until it is restarted. An unauthenticated attacker with ADJACENT network access can use this to cause a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-128990 — xschem 2
summary: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in read_dataset() in src/rawtovcd.c due to an unchecked variable index. Attackers can supply a crafted ngspice .raw file that, when converted with rawtovcd, writes file-controlled heap pointers at chosen signed offsets, corrupting heap memory.

title: CVE-2026-128991 — xschem 2
summary: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_xschem_file() in src/save.c that mishandles embedded-symbol records lacking a preceding instance. Attackers can supply a crafted schematic beginning with a "[" record, causing xschem to read and dereference memory below the instance array and crash.

title: CVE-2026-129092 — CCC Attestation SIG attested-tls-poc through commit 731ca82 contains a time-of-check time-of-use vulnerability because Evidence is appraised only once
summary: CCC Attestation SIG attested-tls-poc through commit 731ca82 contains a time-of-check time-of-use vulnerability because Evidence is appraised only once during the TLS handshake, without post-handshake re-attestation. Attackers with local access to the attesting endpoint can alter workload code, data, configuration, or attached devices like GPUs while peers keep trusting the original Evidence.

title: CVE-2026-82175 — Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability
summary: Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. A high-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to reach internal network services from the appliance.

summary: Huatian Dynamic OA8000 collaborative office system contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in /OAapp/jsp/trace/ntkodownload.jsp, where the filename request parameter is used to locate a file without restricting access to an intended directory or rejecting traversal sequences. Attackers can supply ../ sequences to read arbitrary files from the server, such as the Tomcat configuration at ROOT/WEB-INF/web.xml, exposing sensitive configuration, source, and credential material that can enable further compromise. title: CVE-2026-103813 — Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability
summary: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.

summary: Improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in the WAMP-CRA (challenge-response) authentication path in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote attackers to guess user passwords via unlimited authentication attempts, because the path, in which the broker issues a challenge and the client returns an HMAC of it keyed with the user's secret, applies no account lockout or rate limiting. title: CVE-2026-105623 — The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 serves production JavaScript source maps without authentication, which allows remote attackers to obtain the complete front-end source code, including API usage and internal client logic, via requests for the source map files.

title: CVE-2026-105624 — The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies per-account lockout on repeated failed login attempts, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (temporary lockout of targeted user accounts from the web interface, repeatable for as long as the attack continues) via repeated failed login requests for a known or guessed username. Intercom call handling is not affected.

title: CVE-2026-105625 — The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 loads an integration iframe without sandboxing or origin restrictions, which allows remote attackers to present phishing content to authenticated users via a crafted frame source.

title: CVE-2026-105671 — The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 returns different error responses depending on whether a submitted username exists, which allows remote attackers to enumerate valid user accounts via crafted login requests.

title: CVE-2026-109091 — A buffer overflow in handling EDID Display-Range descriptors in X
summary: A buffer overflow in handling EDID Display-Range descriptors in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by malicious monitors to crash the x server or execute cote.

title: CVE-2026-111545 — Dell PowerStore contains a SQL Injection vulnerability
summary: Dell PowerStore contains a SQL Injection vulnerability. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to disclosure of stored private keys and tampering with trusted certificates.

summary:

title: CVE-2026-126817 — A flaw in the automatic client-side encryption schema generation of the Mongoid ODM may cause values that an application declared for encryption to be
summary: A flaw in the automatic client-side encryption schema generation of the Mongoid ODM may cause values that an application declared for encryption to be written and stored as cleartext when more than one model is mapped onto the same storage location. No error or warning is raised. A party holding an ordinary read-only database account, with no access to the encryption key material, may then obtain those values in clear form.

title: CVE-2026-126818 — A Ruby object-document mapper does not apply its automatic field-level encryption configuration to certain fields when the data model uses class inher
summary: A Ruby object-document mapper does not apply its automatic field-level encryption configuration to certain fields when the data model uses class inheritance. Values the application designated for encryption are written to the database in readable form without any error or warning. A database account holding only read access to the application's collections, and no access to the encryption key store, may obtain those values.

title: CVE-2026-128034 — In gittuf before 0
summary: In gittuf before 0.18.0, verification of file protection rules uses the quoted, escaped pathnames that Git prints by default for files with special characters (for example non-ASCII characters) instead of the raw paths. Such paths do not match patterns like file:internal/*, so the files are treated as unprotected, and a user who is not authorized by a file protection rule can change a protected file whose name contains special characters and still pass verification.

title: CVE-2026-128035 — In gittuf 0
summary: In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.17.0, the verification workflow does not load policy updates that are propagated from an upstream (controller) repository and recorded in the reference state log after the first entry being verified. Only the propagated policy in effect at the start of verification is applied, so later controller changes to global rules, such as threshold requirements and force-push blocks, are ignored and changes that these rules should block pass verification.

title: CVE-2026-128036 — In gittuf 0
summary: In gittuf 0.4.0 through 0.16.0, when a policy update appears within the range of reference state log entries being verified, verification checks only the root of trust signatures of the new policy and not the signatures of its other metadata (rule files). A user trusted to push to the repository who bypasses gittuf policy apply and writes the policy reference and reference state log directly can make an invalid policy apply during verification, weakening or strengthening the rules for later changes. The update is still recorded in the reference state log.

title: CVE-2026-128037 — In gittuf 0
summary: In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.15.0, when a minimum threshold global rule and a policy rule protect the same namespace, verification gives the global rule's check over all trusted users in the policy precedence over the policy rule's own authorized users. A user listed in the policy file but not authorized by the policy rule, or fewer users than the rule's threshold, can make changes to the protected namespace that pass verification.

title: CVE-2026-129094 — @utcp/http before 1
summary: @utcp/http before 1.1.14 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote manuals to reach loopback services by bypassing the remote-loopback check with a {host} placeholder. Attackers can supply host arguments like 127.0.0.1 or register tools via Streamable HTTP and SSE discovery to access internal services on the agent machine.

title: CVE-2026-129099 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to run root commands by importing a malicious OpenVPN client configuration. Attackers can include tls-verify or ipchange directives, which the incomplete denylist does not filter, to execute commands as root when the router connects to an attacker-controlled VPN endpoint.

title: CVE-2026-129100 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by uploading crafted OpenVPN private or tls-auth keys. Attackers can close the inline key block with </key>, inject directives such as tls-verify that bypass the .ovpn denylist, and have OpenVPN execute the hook as root.

title: CVE-2026-129101 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the vpn.set_conf App RPC method that allows authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary OpenVPN server options. Attackers can set enabled=1 and a malicious up option in the openvpns object, which the openvpn-hotplug wrapper executes via /bin/sh as root.

title: CVE-2026-129102 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by injecting newlines into the IPsec keyexchange field of the vpn.set_conf RPC method. Attackers can append a second leftupdown directive to ipsec.conf, which StrongSwan's updown plugin runs as root when an attacker-controlled peer establishes the CHILD_SA.

title: CVE-2026-129103 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by injecting newlines into reboot_time. Attackers can submit a reboot_time value followed by a newline and crontab line, which /etc/init.d/autoreboot writes to the root crontab for crond to run.

title: CVE-2026-129104 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a dnsmasq configuration injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject directives by embedding a newline in the net.set_dhcp leasetime field. Attackers can append address= entries via /etc/init.d/dnsmasq to alter DNS answers for LAN clients, or insert invalid lines that stop dnsmasq.

title: CVE-2026-129105 — Cudy TR3000 before 2
summary: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an option injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary pppd options by embedding quotes and newlines in L2TP credentials. Attackers can submit crafted usernames or passwords to the net.set_wan RPC method, which l2tp.sh writes into a pppd options file, adding options like logfile to the root pppd process.

title: CVE-2026-129110 — sysPass 3
summary: sysPass 3.0.1 through 3.2.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reinstall an already-installed instance by POSTing to the install/install handler, which never checks isInstalled(). Attackers can overwrite config.xml, point the application at an attacker-controlled database, create an administrator account, and plant serialized PublicLink gadget chains triggered via account/viewLink to execute commands.

title: CVE-2026-49341 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.5.1, there is a remotely reachable denial-of-service vulnerability in bacnet-stack affecting the default demo server built from the unmodified apps/server/main.c. This issue has been patched in version 1.5.1.

title: CVE-2026-49990 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. From versions 1.4.2 to before 1.4.5, and 1.5.0 to before 1.5.1, a signed fileStartPosition taken from AtomicReadFile and AtomicWriteFile stream-access requests is not validated tightly enough before it reaches the RAM file backends. Practical impact includes: reliable denial of service via process crash, out-of-bounds read that may expose adjacent memory contents, or out-of-bounds write that may corrupt heap memory and destabilize the process. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5 and 1.5.1.

title: CVE-2026-52787 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0-rc2, a reachable out-of-bounds write exists when encoding the device.address-binding property. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0-rc2.

title: CVE-2026-52788 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, the bsc_node_parse_urls() function in src/bacnet/datalink/bsc/bsc-node.c contains three distinct bugs when parsing space-separated WebSocket URIs from a BACnet/SC Address Resolution ACK message. Two bugs cause out-of-bounds writes past the utf8_urls[10][129] array in the static BSC_ADDRESS_RESOLUTION structure. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-52789 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability exists in the BACnet stack's ReadPropertyMultiple (RPM) handler. When processing a malformed RPM request packet that lacks the expected closing tags, the function handler_read_property_multiple enters an infinite loop. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-52790 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, there is a library-level memory safety issue that is reachable from an unmodified official sample server (apps/server-basic/main.c) over BACnet/IP resulting in a stack-use-after-return in writable Device string properties. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-58265 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a BACnet/SC peer can trigger a heap out-of-bounds read (up to 3 bytes), pre-authentication, in the BACnet/SC header-option decoder. bvlc_sc_decode_proprietary_option() reads the vendor-id and option-type at fixed offsets [3],[4],[5] before checking the option's declared header length, and the option-list validator never enforces a minimum length for proprietary options. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-58498 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, there is a remote global-buffer-overflow in the official router-ipv6 application shipped with bacnet-stack, this results in an out-of-bounds write to the global transmit buffer under ASan. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-62972 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, lighting_command_decode in src/bacnet/lighting.c decodes its first field with the bounded apdu_size - apdu_len, but every nested decode in the operation switch is called with the original full apdu_size while the read pointer has been advanced to &apdu[apdu_len]. The leaf decoders bound their reads against the size they are told, so they read up to apdu_len bytes past the end of the caller's buffer, resulting in an out-of-bounds read. title: CVE-2026-62973 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a remote out-of-bounds read exists in the official BACnet client application apps/readpropm in bacnet-stack commit e2bdbf6. When readpropm sends a legitimate ReadPropertyMultiple request to a malicious BACnet/IP peer, the peer can reply with a malformed but structurally valid ReadPropertyMultiple-ACK that drives the client into a global-buffer-overflow read on the global receive buffer Rx_Buf. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-62974 — BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems
summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a malformed but non-empty BACnet WriteProperty request can drive the official server demo into a non-terminating request-processing loop with repeated heap-backed side effects. This results in a remote unauthenticated denial of service via uncontrolled resource consumption and a non-terminating request path. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-63079 — RBH Access Technologies Integra32 Security Management System 5
summary: RBH Access Technologies Integra32 Security Management System 5.1.11 R5.0 contains an unauthenticated deserialization vulnerability in its deprecated .NET Remoting service, exposed on TCP port 2001 via the AxcvcLt.dll library using BinaryServerFormatterSinkProvider at TypeFilterLevel.Full without requiring authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can send a malicious serialized gadget payload (such as a ysoserial.net TypeConfuseDelegate chain) to the IntegraURI object endpoint, or exploit MarshalByRefObject/MarshalByValue unmarshalling for arbitrary file read/write and SMB/NTLMv2 crede

title: CVE-2026-82174 — Dell PowerStore contains a content-injection vulnerability
summary: Dell PowerStore contains a content-injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to display misleading text on the genuine login page for phishing.

title: CVE-2026-95377 — OS command injection in the TFTP provisioning module of Zenitel EdgeAudioClient before 9
summary:
OS command injection in the TFTP provisioning module of Zenitel EdgeAudioClient before 9.6.3.0, and 10.x before 10.1.3.0, on VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted DHCP option 66 (TFTP Server Name) value supplied by a rogue DHCP server on the same network segment. The DHCP-supplied value is passed to a shell without sanitization. Devices using DHCP, the default configuration, are affected on every boot and lease renewal.



The same injection is also reachable via the config_update_tftp_serv

title: CVE-2026-95378 — Path traversal in the certificate upload endpoint (/api/certificate/upload) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN,
summary:
Path traversal in the certificate upload endpoint (/api/certificate/upload) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files as root via a crafted filename parameter in a multipart upload request when the type field is set to any value other than https_certificate. In that case, both path validation and certificate content validation are skipped.



This can be escalated to arbitrary code execution as root, for example by overwriting start

title: CVE-2026-95379 — Path traversal in the certificate
summary:
Path traversal in the certificate.deleteCertificate JSON-RPC method (POST /api/rpc) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to delete arbitrary files as root via a relative path (../) in the file_name parameter.



This can be used to cause denial of service or render the device inoperable by removing critical system files, and to weaken device security by removing files such as firewall rules or certificate trust stores.

title: CVE-2026-95613 — The pREST database REST API in Zenitel Connect firmware before 1
summary: The pREST database REST API in Zenitel Connect firmware before 1.11.0 signs and verifies JWTs with the platform CA private key, which is stored on a data volume shared between containers, and sets the PostgreSQL session role from the unvalidated sub claim of each request while connected to the database as the "postgres" superuser, which allows local attackers who can read the platform CA private key from the container filesystem to execute database operations as the PostgreSQL superuser, including reading the master encryption key and password hashes, via a forged JWT with sub=postgres sent to

title: CVE-2026-95614 — The host configuration watcher in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: The host configuration watcher in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies a rsyslog configuration file written to a data volume that is shared with the hiatus application container, which allows local attackers with write access to the hiatus container filesystem to execute arbitrary OS commands as root on the host operating system via a crafted rsyslog configuration file.

title: CVE-2026-95615 — OS command injection vulnerability in audio messages API in Zenitel Connect before 1
summary: OS command injection vulnerability in audio messages API in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands as root in the hiatus application container via filename parameter to the /api/system/audio_messages endpoint.

summary:
Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to occupy a BEAM scheduler indefinitely via a client-streaming or bidirectional-streaming request whose body ends inside a gRPC message.

GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.read_stream/1 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy.ex, and the Cowboy adapter in grpc before the package split) asks for more data whenever the buffer does not hold a complete message. summary:
Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via client-streaming or bidirectional-streaming requests.

The streaming read clause of GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.Handler.info/3 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy/handler.ex) asks Cowboy for up to 8,000,000 bytes per read and compares the running total with max_body_size only after the read returns. title: CVE-2026-128986 — In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1
summary:
In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1.1.3, ABAC-enabled deployments match `ROUTE` access rules against the fully decoded request path, while the router routes on the raw, still encoded path. An encoded slash (`%2F`) inside a path value is a segment separator for the access check but part of the value for the router, so a request can match a narrow `ROUTE` rule while the handler returns a different, larger resource.

title: CVE-2026-129116 — C-Kermit from 7
summary: C-Kermit from 7.0.197 before 11.1.515 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the IKSD SSL build that leaves Telnet authentication state at AUTH_VALID after a refused certificate login. Attackers holding a trusted certificate mapped to a refused account can log in as any other account with any password, gaining that account's shell access.

title: CVE-2026-129117 — C-Kermit 8
summary: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows machine-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate Telnet servers because ssl_reply() never calls ssl_check_server_name(). Attackers can refuse START-TLS, offer Telnet AUTHENTICATION SSL, and present any trusted CA certificate to capture user credentials and session data.

title: CVE-2026-129118 — C-Kermit 8
summary: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains an improper certificate hostname validation vulnerability that allows attackers to impersonate hosts by abusing wildcard matching in dNSName_cmp() in ck_ssl.c. Attackers holding a trusted certificate with over-matching names containing asterisks, question marks, brackets, or empty labels can intercept credentials and data over Telnet, FTP, and HTTP TLS connections.

title: CVE-2026-129119 — C-Kermit from 6
summary: C-Kermit from 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a file collision protection bypass that allows malicious senders to append data to existing files by marking transfers as RESEND. The gattr() function in ckcfn3.c clears the REJECT discard flag and switches to APPEND without a RECEIVE CONFIRM prompt, letting attackers modify files such as shell startup files.

title: CVE-2026-129120 — C-Kermit 11
summary: C-Kermit 11.0.506 before 11.1.515 contains a RECEIVE CONFIRM bypass vulnerability that allows malicious Kermit servers to write unrequested files without prompting by abusing recursive GET root computation in ckcfns.c. Attackers can send files such as .ssh/authorized_keys or shell startup files under the current directory, which rq_under_root() accepts silently, enabling persistent access or code execution.

title: CVE-2026-129121 — C-Kermit 8
summary: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains a path traversal vulnerability in doftpget() in ckcftp.c that allows malicious FTP servers to write files outside the intended directory. Attackers can return absolute paths, tilde names, or dot-dot components in NLST or MLSD listings during MGET /RECURSIVE to overwrite files like .bashrc, leading to code execution.

title: CVE-2026-129122 — C-Kermit 6
summary: C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in tn_snenv() in ckctel.c that allows malicious Telnet servers to corrupt client memory via crafted NEW-ENVIRON SEND subnegotiation. Malicious or machine-in-the-middle servers can send oversized variable names before authentication, overflowing a 16-byte stack buffer and a miscomputed heap buffer to corrupt stack and heap memory.

title: CVE-2026-129123 — C-Kermit 8
summary: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in getreply() in ckcftp.c that allows malicious FTP servers to overwrite client memory by sending overlong security replies. Attackers controlling or intercepting an FTP server can send long PBSZ replies after AUTH TLS, or long ADAT replies in GSSAPI, Kerberos 4, and SRP builds, overflowing the static reply_buf with attacker-controlled bytes.

title: CVE-2026-129124 — C-Kermit before 11
summary: C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote clients to execute shell commands by supplying unquoted arguments to REMOTE WHO or REMOTE SPACE. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to arguments passed through WHOCMD or SPACM2 to syscmd(), executing commands on the server host even when DISABLE HOST is set.

title: CVE-2026-129125 — C-Kermit 6
summary: C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows Kermit clients to run shell commands on servers with host commands disabled by abusing REMOTE QUERY evaluation. Attackers can send a REMOTE QUERY invoking the command function, or define a macro via REMOTE ASSIGN and call execute to reach RUN, bypassing the nopush restriction and DISABLE HOST.

title: CVE-2026-129126 — C-Kermit before 11
summary: C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in putsrv() in ckcfns.c that allows malicious peers to write past the srvcmd buffer by sending crafted packets. Attackers can use Kermit repeat-count compression in server command, GET, or file-header packets to write attacker-chosen bytes beyond the heap buffer on servers or receiving instances.

title: CVE-2026-129127 — SQLBot through 1
summary: SQLBot through 1.10.3 contains a weak password hashing vulnerability that stores local account passwords in sys_user.password as unsalted MD5 digests via md5pwd() in security.py. Attackers who obtain the user table can recover passwords, including administrator passwords, using precomputed tables or GPU cracking, since identical passwords produce identical hashes.

title: CVE-2026-129128 — Goose CLI 1
summary: Goose CLI 1.35.0 before 1.53.0 contains a local code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands by setting diff.external in a repository's .git/config. Attackers can ship a crafted repository that, when the victim runs goose review, executes git diff without --no-ext-diff, running commands as the user and exposing credentials and provider API keys.

title: CVE-2026-129129 — AiSOC 12
summary: AiSOC 12.1.0 before 23.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to query the enrichment service through Next.js console rewrite routes. Attackers can send requests to /api/v1/enrichment/lookup or /api/v1/enrichment/bulk to retrieve threat-intelligence results and set force to true to consume commercial provider API quota.

title: CVE-2026-129130 — agent-device from 0
summary: agent-device from 0.21.36 before 0.21.37 contains a local file disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated remote callers to read daemon-host files by opening file:// URLs. Attackers can send an open command with a file:// target through /rpc, then issue snapshot to read any plaintext file readable by the daemon account.

title: CVE-2026-129131 — Gameyfin before 2
summary: Gameyfin before 2.6.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass login-required mode by calling Hilla endpoints annotated with @AnonymousAllowed. Attackers can POST to synchronous endpoint methods such as GameEndpoint.sync, which LiveSubscriptionSecurity never checks, to retrieve game catalog metadata, libraries, platforms, plugins and game requests.

title: CVE-2026-129132 — MRBS before 1
summary: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains an LDAP injection vulnerability in web/lib/MRBS/Auth/AuthLdap.php that interpolates unescaped login usernames into DN search and group-membership filters. Attackers with valid directory credentials outside the required group can submit crafted usernames that make the group filter always true, bypassing access restrictions.

title: CVE-2026-129133 — MRBS before 1
summary: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject spreadsheet formulas because the escape() function in web/report.php fails to neutralize leading formula characters. Attackers can store formulas in booking names, descriptions or custom fields that execute when privileged users open exported CSV reports, enabling data exfiltration or command execution via DDE.

title: CVE-2026-129134 — MRBS before 1
summary: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect reset links by forging the Host header when $url_base is unset. Attackers can request a reset for a victim so AuthDb::notifyUser() emails a link pointing to their host, capturing the reset key when opened to take over accounts including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-129135 — picoquic before 2026
summary: picoquic before 2026.11.05.3e2e3d3 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in picoquic_decode_time_stamp_frame() that allows remote QUIC peers to corrupt stored timestamps by sending oversized TIME_STAMP values. Attackers on connections negotiating the TIME_STAMP extension can send large values shifted by ack_delay_exponent to wrap the result, corrupting RTT and bandwidth estimation and degrading congestion control.

title: CVE-2026-63150 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge privileged actions such as administrator user creation by merging $_GET and $_POST parameters without requiring an anti-CSRF token. Attackers can craft a malicious link or auto-navigating page that issues a plain GET request, exploiting the lack of CSRF protection and SameSite=Lax cookie behavior on top-level navigations to create unauthorized administrator accounts.

title: CVE-2026-63151 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private calendar data by exploiting a missing dateCrea value that causes the md5Id token to collapse to md5(calendarId.userId), both small enumerable integers. Attackers can compute valid tokens and request the misc&action=DisplayIcal endpoint with a forged md5Id to read any user's private calendar events without authentication.

title: CVE-2026-63155 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external URLs by manipulating the objUrl parameter in Ctrl.php's redir() function. Attackers can craft login links with objUrl set to a malicious site, causing the application to issue an HTTP 302 redirect to that external URL, which can be abused for phishing and credential theft.

title: CVE-2026-63164 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access another user's private mail by supplying a crafted reloadMailTypeId parameter to Ctrl::getCurObj() without a readRight() ownership check in CtrlMail.php. Attackers can manipulate the mail identifier value, such as reloadMailTypeId=mail-1, to retrieve the title and body of private messages belonging to other users, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive communications.

title: CVE-2026-63166 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious HTML markup by controlling imported directory data or an uploaded CSV file, as values are rendered into table cell text and value attributes after only Txt::utf8Encode() with no HTML escaping in VuePersonsImportExport.php. Attackers can craft a CSV cell containing an attribute-breakout payload that is rendered verbatim and executed in the browser of the administrator performing the import, leading to arbitrary script execution in the administrative context.

title: CVE-2026-63167 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated general administrators to inject arbitrary SQL by setting the personsSort session value, which is concatenated unsanitized into ORDER BY clauses in MdlUser.php and MdlSpace.php. Attackers can submit an error-based extractvalue payload through personsSort to leak database information, such as the MariaDB version, via the user and space listing pages.

title: CVE-2026-63170 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge the shared-calendar iCal share token by deriving md5Id() from predictable fields such as object creation time, which is self-disclosed through autorDate and the iCal CREATED field. Attackers can compute the creation minute and forge the md5Id token to access and read a shared calendar's iCal feed without authorization.

title: CVE-2026-107398 — Indico is a feature-rich event management system
summary: Indico is a feature-rich event management system. Prior to version 3.3.14, due to a path traversal vulnerability when building an "offline copy" of an event, a malicious event manager has the ability to retrieve the content of any local file that's readable by the user running Indico on the server. This issue has been patched in version 3.3.14.

title: CVE-2026-123177 — A flaw was found in dnf5daemon-server
summary: A flaw was found in dnf5daemon-server. Unauthenticated D-Bus methods pass caller-controlled URL or .rpm path patterns into a root-privileged cmdline package loader that may store fetched content in a world-readable cache without size limits, or open local paths as root, allowing a local attacker to disclose privileged content and to deny service via disk exhaustion.

title: CVE-2026-123965 — A prompt injection vulnerability in all versions of Jet Admin Cloud Platform allows a remote attacker with a free account to expose sensitive
summary: A prompt injection vulnerability in all versions of Jet Admin Cloud Platform allows a remote attacker with a free account to expose sensitive .env configuration files and exfiltrate critical credentials. Mitigated via sandbox component around October 29, 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124041 — Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5
summary: Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the underlying MSSQL database, enabling exfiltration of sensitive property and  taxpayer information.

title: CVE-2026-124666 — Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On a route where multi-auth falls back from wolf-rbac to another successful authenticator, client-supplied Wolf identity headers can remain in the request. A downstream service that relies on those documented headers may therefore receive an identity that was not established by the successful authenticator.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.8.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124679 — Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



On routes using jwe-decrypt with strict: false and a
forward_header distinct from the token header an unauthenticated
client can supply the value the upstream treats as gateway-decrypted
plaintext. Similar can happen when forward-auth is configured with allow_degradation: true, and the auth service is unavailable.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124680 — Interpretation Conflict, resulting in (Incorrect Authorization) vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Interpretation Conflict, resulting in (Incorrect Authorization) vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



An unauthenticated client can reach upstream paths protected
by a route-level auth plugin when a route without auth exists on the
same upstream and the upstream does not collapse encoded dot segments.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 0.9 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124716 — Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



An authenticated user who holds any one of a route's required permissions or scopes can reach the protected upstream without the others, including HTTP methods the authorization server denied.



This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 1.4.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124719 — Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



When a Route's configured headers carry a caller identity and the OpenAPI document declares
the same header, a caller can act as another identity against the
upstream API. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124723 — Interpretation Conflict, leading to Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Interpretation Conflict, leading to Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



With match_uri_encoded_slash enabled and skip_mtls_uri_regex
configured, a client without a certificate can reach an upstream
behind a route that requires one, limited to request paths that decode
to an exempted URI. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-124726 — Relative Path Traversal, with Unintended Proxy vulnerability in Apache APISIX
summary:
Relative Path Traversal, with Unintended Proxy vulnerability in Apache APISIX.



A caller of the MCP endpoint can invoke endpoints the OpenAPI document
never declared, under the declared tool's HTTP method, using the credentials the
Route adds. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-126091 — Dental practice sites hosted with iDentalSoft send a JSON response to any user who loads certain pages containing sensitive information, including OAu
summary: Dental practice sites hosted with iDentalSoft send a JSON response to any user who loads certain pages containing sensitive information, including OAuth credentials, password hashes, and PII. Fixed in iDentalSoft 14.0.3.

From 1.0.3 through 1.7.1, Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber checks SVG href and xlink:href local references with a pattern whose line-start anchor and whitespace class cause an all-whitespace value to be rescanned from each line start. summary: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. summary: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. summary: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. summary: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt parses a request path beginning with // as a URL host before rendering a page, while Nitro server/middleware and routeRules continue to evaluate the original path. An unauthenticated request such as //x/admin can therefore resolve to the /admin page without route-scoped serverHandlers, server/middleware path checks, redirects, or security headers configured for /admin. API handlers in server/api and server/routes, appMiddleware, page middleware are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

title: CVE-2026-128078 — GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package
summary: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 9.5.0 until 10.0.27 and 11.0.9, authenticated users could access ITIL followups, tasks, or solutions generated from templates without a read-permission check on the parent ticket, problem, or change. Depending on the template configuration, this could reveal information from parent items the user could not otherwise read. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.27 and 11.0.9.

title: CVE-2026-128079 — envd provides reproducible development environments for humans and agents
summary: envd provides reproducible development environments for humans and agents. In versions starting with 0.3.38 and before 1.3.6, insufficient containment of host-side requirements-file reads in  install.python_packages(requirements=...)  could allow access to files outside the build context. An attacker able to influence build input could cause file contents interpreted as dependency entries to appear in debug logs or build-step metadata, subject to the envd process’s permissions. Exploitation in version 1.3.5 additionally requires concurrent modification of relevant filesystem paths. This issue

title: CVE-2026-129139 — paicoding from commit b8206b9 through commit 903adce uses predictable credentials for accounts created via ZSXQ login, because loginByZsxq derives bot
summary: paicoding from commit b8206b9 through commit 903adce uses predictable credentials for accounts created via ZSXQ login, because loginByZsxq derives both the username and password solely from the member's ZSXQ number. Unauthenticated attackers can read that number from the victim's /user/{userId} profile page, compute the credentials, and log in via /login/username to take over the account.

title: CVE-2026-129140 — paicoding 1
summary: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in image upload because ImageServiceImpl.validateStaticImg accepts SVG files, which are then served from the site origin when local storage is used. Authenticated attackers can upload script-bearing SVG images that execute when victims view them, stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie to hijack accounts.

title: CVE-2026-129141 — paicoding 1
summary: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because SeoInjectService embeds user profile text without escaping in an inline JSON-LD script element. Authenticated attackers can add a closing script tag followed by HTML to their profile, executing scripts for visitors of their profile page and stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie.

title: CVE-2026-129142 — paicoding commit 766c48b through commit 903adce contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in payment notifications, where NotifyMsgListener
summary: paicoding commit 766c48b through commit 903adce contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in payment notifications, where NotifyMsgListener inserts the payer's display name unescaped and notify-system-item.html renders it via th:utext. Authenticated attackers can set a malicious display name and start a pending payment on a paid article, executing script in the author's browser when the author views notifications.

title: CVE-2026-129143 — paicoding 1
summary: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ArticleRestController article detail endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted articles. Attackers can enumerate article IDs via GET /article/api/data/detail/{articleId} to retrieve full content of paid, login-only, member-only and draft articles.

title: CVE-2026-129144 — paicoding 1
summary: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to unlock paid articles by guessing weak payment confirmation codes. Attackers can start a payment, enumerate roughly 2000 IdUtil.genPayCode counter values, and submit the matching verifyCode to the unauthenticated callback to mark it paid.

title: CVE-2026-129151 — SurveyKing 1
summary: SurveyKing 1.13.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in result lookup: the anonymous survey view leaks the lookup configuration, including its password, and the lookup password check is skipped when no answer is sent. Unauthenticated attackers with a public survey link can inject a % wildcard into the MyBatis LIKE condition to match all responses, then call loadProject with an answerId to read complete responses including hidden fields.

title: CVE-2026-129152 — SurveyKing 1
summary: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit survey responses because AnswerServiceImpl.saveAnswer skips login-required and survey password checks. Attackers can submit responses to protected surveys and set createBy in the request body to impersonate other users, corrupting survey results.

title: CVE-2026-129153 — SurveyKing 1
summary: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authorization bypass in the linked survey feature that fails to verify the referenced linkSurveyId belongs to the caller's own project. Authenticated attackers can point a linked option at another user's survey so that loadLinkResult and updateLinkSurveyAnswer read, rewrite, or create responses in that survey.

title: CVE-2026-129154 — SurveyKing 1
summary: SurveyKing 1.13.0 through 1.13.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the server accepts a respondent-supplied survey snapshot and the frontend renders its titles via innerHTML. Anonymous respondents can submit a forged snapshot embedding event handlers such as img onerror that execute in an administrator's browser session when the response is viewed.

title: CVE-2026-129155 — DjangoBlog 2
summary: DjangoBlog 2.0.0.0 through 2.1.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the class_filter comment sanitizer passes event-handler attributes on span, div, pre and code tags. Authenticated commenters can post a div with autofocus and onfocus attributes, executing script without interaction for every visitor, including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-129156 — DjangoBlog commit d186b1c through commit 6134ed6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated OAuth users to inject
summary: DjangoBlog commit d186b1c through commit 6134ed6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated OAuth users to inject script via an unescaped nickname in comment reactions. Attackers can set their OAuth display name to a payload closing the single-quoted data-reactions attribute, then react to a comment to execute script in article visitors' browsers.

title: CVE-2026-129157 — ragent 1
summary: ragent 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RagTraceController that allows any logged-in user to view all users' RAG traces. Attackers can page through /rag/traces/runs and related node endpoints to read other users' usernames, user ids, conversation ids, questions, and per-node execution details.

title: CVE-2026-129158 — ragent 1
summary: ragent 1.1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by uploading SVG knowledge-base documents served inline as image/svg+xml. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG via /knowledge-base/{kb-id}/docs/upload so that victims opening /knowledge-base/docs/{docId}/file execute it in the application origin, enabling account takeover.

title: CVE-2026-129160 — free-fs 2
summary: free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in FileShareServiceImpl.getPages, which passes the orderBy parameter of the /apis/share/pages endpoint verbatim into the ORDER BY clause via MyBatis-Flex without a column whitelist. Authenticated users can supply CASE WHEN subquery expressions that use share ordering as a boolean oracle to read arbitrary database contents, such as share codes.

title: CVE-2026-129161 — Dromara free-fs 2
summary: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force six-digit password reset codes via PUT /apis/user/forget-password. Attackers can request a code for a known email and submit unlimited guesses during its 300-second lifetime to set a chosen password and take over the account.

title: CVE-2026-129162 — Dromara free-fs 2
summary: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in FileStreamController.preview that allows unauthenticated attackers to download stored files. Attackers who obtain a file ID from share listings or preview links can request /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} to download any user's or workspace's files.

title: CVE-2026-129163 — Dromara free-fs 2
summary: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to run script by uploading HTML files served inline as text/html. Attackers can send a victim the /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} link to execute script in the application origin, calling /apis endpoints to expose the victim's files and account.

title: CVE-2026-129164 — Dromara free-fs 2
summary: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to access code-protected shares because share codes are enforced only client-side. Attackers knowing a share ID can call the share items and download endpoints to list and download files without the code, even on preview-only shares.

title: CVE-2026-129165 — Tactical RMM 0
summary: Tactical RMM 0.17.0 through 1.6.1 contains an arbitrary file read in the /reporting/templates/preview/ endpoint because WeasyPrint resolves file:// links in user-supplied template_md and embeds the files in the returned PDF. Users with report management permission can read the Django SECRET_KEY, reused as the NATS password, and publish runscript commands to every managed agent.

title: CVE-2026-129166 — Keep 0
summary: Keep 0.34.10 through 0.55.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in its CEL-to-SQL converter, which inserts bracket-indexed JSON keys from CEL filters unescaped into JSON path expressions for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Authenticated users with read:alert permission can submit crafted CEL expressions to /alerts/query or the cel parameter of /incidents, using result counts as a boolean oracle to extract other tenants' alerts and password hashes.

title: CVE-2026-129167 — Seafile SeaDoc converter 2
summary: Seafile SeaDoc converter 2.0.4 before 2.0.11 and 3.0.0 before 3.0.8 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers holding a public share token to execute code. Attackers supply an absolute filename to /api/v1/confluence-to-wiki/ to extract a ZIP from download_url into the Python library path, then trigger the module's import via a file-convert request.

title: CVE-2026-129168 — PMail 2
summary: PMail 2.9.1 through 2.9.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the /attachments/{id}/{cid} endpoint returns email attachments verbatim with the sender-supplied Content-Type after cid: references are rewritten into attachment links. Unauthenticated SMTP senders can email a text/html attachment and a page-covering cid link, so a recipient who clicks the message runs script in their webmail session to change passwords, including the administrator's.

title: CVE-2026-129169 — PMail 2
summary: PMail 2.5.0 through 2.9.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by sending unsanitized HTML through /api/email/send. Attackers can embed event-handler payloads like img onerror that execute when administrators view the message, enabling privileged API calls such as password changes for account takeover.

title: CVE-2026-129170 — FileCodeBox 2
summary: FileCodeBox 2.2.1 through 2.8.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in renderMarkdownPreview, which returns unsanitized text when the marked parser throws. Unauthenticated attackers can share text with thousands of nested blockquote markers followed by HTML payloads, executing script that steals the admin token from localStorage.

title: CVE-2026-129171 — NginxPulse 1
summary: NginxPulse 1.5.0 before 1.6.26 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to append SQL via the id and locationType parameters of /api/stats/:type. Attackers can close the quoted table-name identifier and use error-based output to read database contents, and read or write server files via PostgreSQL superuser functions.

title: CVE-2026-129172 — EdgeEver 1
summary: EdgeEver 1.9.0 before 2.13.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the backup restore endpoint PUT /api/v1/restores/json/resources/:id, which accepts a resource kind of image paired with a text/html MIME type without checking consistency. Authenticated members can share the note and send the public blob link to a victim, whose browser executes the script to mint a non-expiring API token granting read and write access to the victim's notes.

title: CVE-2026-63173 — Omnispace Agora Project through 26
summary: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in which the isAutor() function in MdlObject.php grants accessRight=3 based solely on object authorship without verifying the user still belongs to the object's space. Attackers who were previously members and authored objects can retain unauthorized read access to space objects even after being removed from the space, leading to persistent information disclosure.

summary: An Out-Of-Bounds Write due to missing input validation is possible in the autoprogramming interface of SpaceCom and Space Battery pack with WiFi which could lead to a denial of service of the affected communication device.

summary: There exists an improper privilege management vulnerability that could cause privilege escalation at the SpaceCom and Space Battery pack SP with WiFi.

The /login route accepted a user-supplied next query parameter and passed it directly to Flask's redirect() function without validating the destination. An attacker could craft a URL such as https://victim-host/login?next=https://attacker.example/phish and deliver it to a user (e.g., via email or a lookalike page). After the user successfully authenticated, the application issued a 302 redirect to the attacker-controlled external URL. This enables phishing attacks where a user, believing they are

title: CVE-2026-59074 — Edito CMS is vulnerable to improper cryptographic signature verification in the JWT refresh logic
summary:
Edito CMS is vulnerable to improper cryptographic signature verification in the JWT refresh logic. An authenticated low-privilege user can submit self-crafted​ ​JWT​ containing​ ​an existing user​ ​identifier and, due to the lack of signature validation,​​  obtain​ ​a ​​valid,​​ fully-signed​​ session ​​token​​ for​​ any ​​account ​​in​ ​the​ ​system. This allows the attacker to impersonate any user, including administrators.
This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59075 — Edito CMS is vulnerable to Dynamic LINQ injection
summary:
Edito CMS is vulnerable to Dynamic LINQ injection. Due to improper input validation, an authenticated attacker can inject conditional expressions into the sort parameter of paginated administrative endpoints. Analyzing the returned result order allows the attacker to extract value of any field character by character, leading to potential exposure of sensitive data.


This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59076 — Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
summary:
Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). Due to improper input validation, an authenticated attacker can inject malicious scripts into givenName and surname parameters via the /api/auth/profile endpoint. When an administrator visits the admin changelog logs, the injected script is automatically executed, in his browser.


This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59077 — Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored XSS via content parameter in Tiny editor functionality
summary:
Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored XSS via content parameter in Tiny editor functionality. Authenticated attacker can inject arbitrary HTML and JS into website, which will be rendered/executed when user tries to edit changed entry.

This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59078 — Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored XSS in avatar upload functionality
summary:
Edito CMS is vulnerable to Stored XSS in avatar upload functionality. Authenticated attacker can inject arbitrary HTML and JS into website, which will be rendered/executed when visiting an URL leading to a edited avatar.

This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59079 — Edito CMS restricts the ability to upload files via the UI to specific file types
summary:
Edito CMS restricts the ability to upload files via the UI to specific file types. However, an avatar upload functionality allows an attacker to upload files of any type and extension without restriction.
This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-59080 — Edito CMS sends JWT token via GET requests
summary:
Edito CMS sends JWT token via GET requests. This allows a local attacker with access to browser history to obtain valid JWT token and perform action on behalf of the victim. The token is valid for only short period of time; after that time, it expires and can no longer be used.



The vendor assessed the likelihood of exploitation as very low and determined that a fix is not necessary.

title: CVE-2026-59081 — Edito CMS deserializes JSON data without further validation
summary:
Edito CMS deserializes JSON data without further validation. A user (even an administrator) cannot exploit this vulnerability through the application's normal functionality. An attacker who could modify cache entries or inject them could execute code on the server.




This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

title: CVE-2026-128824 — A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay
summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. The v1 registry API error handler reflects the attacker-supplied image_id path segment in a response served as text/html, allowing a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) attack. By tricking a user into visiting a specially crafted URL, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser within the Quay origin, potentially compromising the user's session.

title: CVE-2023-54423 — OpenMage magento-lts before 20
summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor fails to filter scripts in specially crafted HTML tags. Attackers can inject an img element with a malicious onmouseover attribute to execute scripts in the browsers of users viewing the rendered content.

title: CVE-2024-58404 — Zipline versions from 3
summary: Zipline versions from 3.4.5 before 3.7.10 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the user data export endpoint via the name query parameter. Authenticated attackers can bypass the user id check and use directory traversal sequences to read arbitrary files on the server host.

title: CVE-2024-58405 — Zipline through 3
summary: Zipline through 3.7.9 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the /api/auth/register endpoint, which enforces invite codes only when user registration is disabled, so registration succeeds without an invite when both invites and user registration are enabled. Unauthenticated attackers can send a direct POST request omitting the invite code to create accounts, view stats, and exhaust storage by uploading many files.

title: CVE-2025-71459 — Zipline through 4
summary: Zipline through 4.3.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated uploaders to write files outside the upload directory by supplying traversal sequences in the x-zipline-filename header. Attackers using the local datasource can create or overwrite files writable by the Zipline process, corrupting application data or disrupting service.

title: CVE-2025-71460 — Zipline before 4
summary: Zipline before 4.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/user/files/transaction endpoint that allows authenticated users to modify other users' files due to absent ownership checks. Attackers who know a target file ID can submit transaction requests to edit or delete files belonging to any user.

title: CVE-2025-71461 — Zipline before 4
summary: Zipline before 4.0.2 contains a predictable filename vulnerability that allows attackers to infer other users' upload filenames by recovering the Math.random generator state. Attackers with five consecutive gfycat-style filenames can reconstruct the random state to predict previous and future filenames until the instance restarts, exposing private uploads.

title: CVE-2025-71462 — Zipline before 3
summary: Zipline before 3.7.12 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the login page that allows attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying an unvalidated url parameter. Attackers can craft a login link with a javascript: URI in the url parameter that executes in the victim's browser after login.

title: CVE-2025-71463 — Scapy before 2
summary: Scapy before 2.7.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the load_session function that allows attackers to execute code by supplying a malicious pickle session file. Attackers can trick users into loading a crafted .pkl.gz file via the -s option or conf.session, executing embedded Python code through __reduce__().

summary: The WPZOOM Addons for Elementor – Starter Templates & Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'actions[save_builder][data][elements][...][settings][regions][i][link][url] / [pins][i][link][url]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. title: CVE-2026-126264 — SiYuan before 3
summary: SiYuan before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated Reader users to retrieve credential-named widget files by bypassing the sensitive-path guard in getFile. Attackers can request paths like /data/widgets/<package>/credentials.json for publish-referenced widgets to obtain API keys, tokens, or other stored secrets.

title: CVE-2026-126265 — SiYuan 2
summary: SiYuan 2.1.0 before 3.8.9 contains a flaw where the loginAuth CAPTCHA challenge lives in a signed client-side cookie, allowing reuse of a solved challenge. Attackers can replay the original signed siyuan cookie with distinct wrong access codes to brute-force the code and gain an administrator session.

title: CVE-2026-126266 — SiYuan from 3
summary: SiYuan from 3.6.0 before 3.8.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated publish visitors to bypass per-document passwords via regex search in getDoc. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/filetree/getDoc with queryMethod 3 and a broad regex to read protected body text returned in the unfiltered keywords field.

title: CVE-2026-126267 — NocoDB from 0
summary: NocoDB from 0.300.0 before 2026.04.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to crash the server by triggering an unhandled promise rejection in MetaService metadata logging. Attackers can send a request leaving a lookup condition undefined, causing knex binding errors in the unawaited logHelper call that terminate the server process.

title: CVE-2026-126268 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an IP address spoofing vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge their recorded source IP by supplying X-Forwarded-For headers, because Express trust proxy is enabled unconditionally. Attackers can write arbitrary source addresses into audit and request logs to mislead investigations and evade the per-address public API rate limiter.

title: CVE-2026-126269 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to execute scripts by storing crafted attachment MIME types like text/html;image/png. Attackers can write the value through the records API so the /dltemp signed URL serves HTML inline, stealing session tokens from localStorage to impersonate victims.

title: CVE-2026-126270 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the aggregated meta info route of utils.controller.ts that exposes instance-wide metadata to anonymous callers. Unauthenticated attackers can request the endpoint to enumerate bases, user counts, shared and password-protected view counts, webhook counts, and live per-base row counts, while repeated requests amplify database query load.

title: CVE-2026-126271 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated base Viewers to obtain TLS client private keys by reading a base's data source. The source read handler masked only the connection password, letting attackers retrieve the decrypted private key, client certificate and CA to connect directly to the external database, bypassing NocoDB permissions.

title: CVE-2026-126272 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass bulk row-count limits by using session authentication instead of API tokens. Attackers with Editor write permission on one table can submit hundreds of thousands of rows to v1 and v2 bulk write routes, exhausting database connections, CPU, and memory.

title: CVE-2026-126273 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in initAdminFromEnv.ts that silently skips super-admin bootstrap when the admin password environment variable is empty. Unauthenticated attackers can call the public signup endpoint first on a fresh instance to receive Creator and Super Admin roles, gaining full administrative control.

title: CVE-2026-126274 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator users to inject script by embedding markup in column or table titles. The Delete.vue confirmation dialog renders these titles through an unescaped innerHTML binding, executing script when a victim deletes an external-source table to steal session tokens from localStorage.

title: CVE-2026-126275 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-base row comments by supplying only model and row ids. Attackers with a Viewer or Creator role on an unrelated base can read private comments and author emails, or plant decoy tables and duplicate comment ids to spoof teammates' comments.

title: CVE-2026-126276 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that treats PKCE as a substitute for confidential client authentication, skipping client secret verification when omitted. Attackers holding a captured authorization code and PKCE verifier can mint access tokens and 60-day refresh tokens for a confidential client without knowing its secret.

title: CVE-2026-126277 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources by sending unbounded filter arrays to shared-view bulk endpoints. Attackers with a shared view UUID can POST a large body of minimal filter objects, triggering a full database query per entry, to crash the NocoDB process.

title: CVE-2026-126278 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains a race condition vulnerability in users.service.ts that allows holders of a valid reset token to perform multiple password changes by sending concurrent reset requests. Attackers can exploit the window created by slow bcrypt hashing before the token is cleared to overwrite the owner's new password and lock them out.

title: CVE-2026-126279 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in PromptWithFields.vue that renders unescaped field references from AI field prompts as HTML in a tooltip. Attackers with the Creator role or above can store markup in a prompt's field reference that executes when victims open the field configuration, stealing the localStorage session token to call authenticated APIs as the victim.

title: CVE-2026-126280 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a race condition in refresh-token rotation that allows attackers to reuse tokens because UserRefreshToken.ts never checks the affected-row count. Attackers holding a captured refresh token can present it concurrently with the legitimate user to obtain a valid authenticated session, and no reuse event is recorded.

title: CVE-2026-126281 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the copy-from branch of integration creation in integrations.service.ts that decrypts a source integration's connection credentials without checking its owner or private flag. Authenticated users with the Creator role can supply guessed or enumerated integration ids to copy other users' private database host, username, and password into an integration they own.

title: CVE-2026-126282 — NocoDB from 2026
summary: NocoDB from 2026.04.0 before 2026.08.0 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in org-users.service.ts where updating a user's legacy organization role rewrites their default-workspace role. Revoked users can silently regain Creator-level read, write and schema modification access across all default-workspace bases using their existing session token.

title: CVE-2026-126283 — NocoDB before 2026
summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets base-scoped API tokens act as account-wide credentials because the token's base_id is never stored or checked. Attackers holding a leaked token can read, write and delete records on every base the token owner belongs to, including bases joined later.

title: CVE-2026-126284 — NocoDB from 2026
summary: NocoDB from 2026.05.2 before 2026.07.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Editor-role users to fetch internal URLs because data import reused the webhook internal-network exemption.
