title: CVE-2026-126766 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to set an incident's reporter to another user by supplying a client-controlled reporter field. Attackers can send crafted POST /api/v1/incidents or PATCH /api/v1/incidents/{id}/status requests to falsify incident attribution and corrupt the accountability audit trail.

title: CVE-2026-126767 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a prompt injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to disclose the hidden system prompt by submitting crafted chat input to POST /api/v1/rca/chat. Attackers can instruct the assistant to ignore its rules and reveal internal orchestration instructions, aiding the crafting of further prompt injection attacks.

title: CVE-2026-126768 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid JWTs by setting the client-controlled is_local_auth field. Attackers can send a POST /api/v1/user/login/ request for the admin account with an invalid password and is_local_auth true to gain SuperUser administrative access.

title: CVE-2026-126769 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access Governance API endpoints, including /api/v1/databases. Attackers can send requests without an Authorization header, or with invalid or tampered JWT tokens, to retrieve stored database hosts, usernames, and passwords.

title: CVE-2026-126770 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the backend connect to arbitrary destinations through the database Test Connection feature. Attackers can set a database entry's host and port to localhost, internal addresses, or attacker-controlled servers to probe internal hosts and ports reachable from the REMS server.

title: CVE-2026-126771 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to inject scripts by uploading attachments with spoofed text/html Content-Type. Attackers can upload HTML files named like test.html.pdf that render in the REMS origin via Preview, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers.

title: CVE-2026-126772 — OpsTree REMS through 1
summary: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an improper attribution vulnerability that allows authenticated users to post comments as the incident creator via POST /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/comment. Lower-privileged attackers can comment on incidents owned by users such as a Super User to impersonate them and corrupt the incident timeline and audit trail.

title: CVE-2026-126774 — @tinacms/mdx before 2
summary: @tinacms/mdx before 2.4.2 contains a code injection vulnerability in its MDX serializer, which writes rich-text values into MDX expressions without escaping them. Authenticated content editors can save crafted values that break out of list field or highlightColor expressions in the stored .mdx file, executing JavaScript in visitors' browsers or on build and server-side rendering hosts.

title: CVE-2026-126775 — Social-auth-core 4
summary: Social-auth-core 4.7.0 before 7.0.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the SAML backend that restores sessions named in the unsigned RelayState parameter. Attackers can deliver their own valid IdP response and RelayState to a victim's browser via an auto-submitting form, signing the victim into the attacker's account to capture entered data.

title: CVE-2026-126776 — SiYuan 3
summary: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.10 on Windows contains a path traversal vulnerability in kernel/util/webfetch.go that allows attackers to write files outside the import directory via backslash-encoded filenames. Attackers controlling a URL fetched by the MCP web_fetch or http_request tools can use %5C-encoded ..\ sequences to write chosen response bytes to directories above temp/import that are writable by the SiYuan user.

title: CVE-2026-126777 — Traccar 3
summary: Traccar 3.15 before 6.17.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in LdapProvider.login() that fails to reject empty passwords, causing LDAP binds to be performed as unauthenticated binds when LDAP authentication is enabled. Unauthenticated attackers who know a valid username can log in via POST /api/session or HTTP Basic authentication with an empty password against directories that permit unauthenticated binds, obtaining sessions for any account including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-126778 — Wallos 4
summary: Wallos 4.4.0 before 5.10.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in endpoints/cronjobs/sendnotifications.php that allows registered users to inject scripts via unescaped notification service responses. Attackers can point their Mattermost webhook URL or Web Push endpoint at a controlled server returning JavaScript, which executes in the administrator's session when sendnotifications.php is opened.

title: CVE-2026-126779 — Spatie Browsershot 2
summary: Spatie Browsershot 2.2.0 before 5.5.0 contains a local file read vulnerability that allows attackers to read server files by supplying root-relative references in HTML passed to setHtml(). Attackers can embed iframe, img, link or script elements referencing paths like /etc/passwd, which resolve to file:// URLs and render file contents into the returned PDF or screenshot.

title: CVE-2026-126780 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in acl/save_group.cgi that allows delegated administrators to grant unauthorized modules by submitting arbitrary module lists in the mod parameter. Attackers with Webmin Users module access can create or edit groups holding modules like Command Shell and assign themselves membership to execute commands as root.

title: CVE-2026-126781 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a users file injection vulnerability in acl/cert_issue.cgi that allows authenticated Webmin users to inject lines by supplying unvalidated certificate DN fields containing newlines. Attackers can end a DN field with a backslash and newline to add a second root entry with a known password hash, gaining Webmin root access after miniserv restarts.

title: CVE-2026-57500 — REVA is an interoperability platform
summary: REVA is an interoperability platform. Prior to versions 2.40.5 and 2.46.4, Reva exposes internal metadata folders in the spaces of an authenticated user. This can lead to unwanted ways of interaction with the data. This issue has been patched in versions 2.40.5 and 2.46.4.

summary: geojson-vt is a JavaScript library for slicing GeoJSON data into vector tiles on the fly, primarily designed to enable rendering and interacting with large geospatial datasets on the browser side (without a server). summary: Icinga Web 2 is an open source monitoring web interface, framework and command-line interface. Prior to versions 2.12.7 and 2.13.1, an attacker can craft a URL that, once visited by an authenticated user (or one that is able to authenticate), allows to manipulate the backend to redirect the user to any location. For this to succeed, the victim's locale in Icinga Web must be different from en_US. This issue has been patched in versions 2.12.7 and 2.13.1.

summary: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. title: CVE-2026-64861 — Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams
summary: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.222.0, the GraphQL endpoint does not enforce restrictions on alias count, query depth, or query complexity. An attacker can send a single request containing thousands of aliased resolver calls, causing excessive server-side resource consumption and service degradation. This issue has been patched in version 0.222.0.

title: CVE-2026-65833 — iopress is a native HTTP server for Node
summary: iopress is a native HTTP server for Node.js with platform-specific async I/O. Prior to version 1.0.5, the chunked-transfer-encoding HTTP request parser in @iopress/core reads past the end of the input buffer when a request declares a chunk size larger than the body actually received. This results in a heap-buffer-over-read. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.5.

title: CVE-2026-65840 — Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions
summary: Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions. Prior to version 0.36.0, in multi-tenant mode (HOST_MODE=multi), an attacker can use an email verification key issued by Tenant A to authenticate as the same email address on Tenant B. This completely bypasses tenant isolation and allows unauthorized account takeover across tenants. Single-host deployments (HOST_MODE=single, the default) are NOT affected. This issue has been patched in version 0.36.0.

title: CVE-2026-65843 — sync-rpc runs asynchronous commands synchronously by putting them in a separate proces
summary: sync-rpc runs asynchronous commands synchronously by putting them in a separate proces. Prior to version 1.3.7, if an attacker could guess the correct port and it was not blocked via a firewall, it was possible to load and execute arbitrary JavaScript files stored on the server running sync-rpc. This issue has been patched in version 1.3.7.

title: CVE-2026-65967 — Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions
summary: Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions. Prior to version 0.34.0, a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in Fider due to insufficient validation of webhook URLs. The application allows user-controlled URLs to be fetched by the server without restricting access to internal or external network resources. This enables attackers with administrative privileges to make arbitrary HTTP requests from the server, potentially accessing internal services or cloud metadata endpoints. This issue has been patched in version 0.34.0.

These messages accumulate without a total-size limit, leading to unbounded memory exhaustion and a denial of service in the `cockpit-ws` service.

title: CVE-2026-91892 — Dell Terraform Provider for PowerFlex, versions prior to 1

An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

title: CVE-2026-122095 — AsiaInfo BSS Platform 9
summary: AsiaInfo BSS Platform 9.2 before 9.2.38 has a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the menu icon upload function. An authenticated user with ordinary application privileges can upload an SVG file containing embedded JavaScript, which is served from the application origin. title: CVE-2026-126784 — Missing rate limiting, per-account submission quota and geographic validation in the publicar_aviso RPC function in Lagarto Chivato 0
summary: Missing rate limiting, per-account submission quota and geographic validation in the publicar_aviso RPC function in Lagarto Chivato 0.4.1 and earlier on Web allows remote authenticated attackers to flood the moderation queue via unlimited submission of notices with arbitrary coordinates.

title: CVE-2026-126815 — Pre-account hijacking in the authentication flow in Lagarto Chivato 0
summary: Pre-account hijacking in the authentication flow in Lagarto Chivato 0.4.1 and earlier on Web allows remote unauthenticated attackers to take over arbitrary accounts via a password planted on an unregistered email address that becomes valid upon the victim’s first passwordless login.

title: CVE-2026-91151 — A flaw was found in Cockpit
summary: A flaw was found in Cockpit. A local authenticated user with control over a target account's home directory can exploit a privileged symlink dereference vulnerability in the `ssh-add-public-key.sh` helper. When this helper runs with elevated privileges, it can be tricked into following attacker-controlled symlinks within the `.ssh` or `authorized_keys` paths. This allows the attacker to arbitrarily change file ownership and modes, potentially leading to local privilege escalation and impacting the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of the system.

title: CVE-2026-100307 — Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1
summary:

summary:
Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in the server registration and update API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry before 1.35.0 might allow an authenticated remote user to send requests from the gateway to internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints and read the responses via a crafted request.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.35.0.

title: CVE-2026-126797 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key. Attackers can sign an HS256 X-Access-Token carrying the public super administrator role ID to gain full access to user management, scan tasks and stored vulnerability results.

title: CVE-2026-126798 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ns-admin URL asset detail dialog that renders crawled form request bodies (Asset_URL.data) via innerHTML without encoding. Attackers can host crafted forms on crawled sites to store JavaScript that executes when users view asset details, stealing localStorage access tokens to hijack sessions, including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-126799 — Gotenberg 8
summary: Gotenberg 8.31.0 before 8.38.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in IsPublicIP() that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass private-IP deny-list protections using IPv6 zone identifiers. Attackers can append a zone such as %25eth0 to the unspecified address or blocked IPv6 prefixes in downloadFrom, webhook, or Chromium/LibreOffice URLs to reach internal services and read responses in the returned PDF.

title: CVE-2026-126800 — Hydro @hydrooj/ui-default before 4
summary: Hydro @hydrooj/ui-default before 4.59.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by placing double quotes in language- class tokens within markdown-it-xss.ts. Attackers can store a payload in their profile bio that executes when administrators or other users view it, stealing the non-httpOnly sid session cookie for session hijacking.

title: CVE-2026-126801 — Rote 1
summary: Rote 1.2.0 through 2.6.0 contains an authorization bypass in the OAuth bind/merge endpoint that allows authenticated users to merge any OAuth-bound account into their own. Attackers can submit a public existingUserId and GitHub or Apple user ID to take over notes, attachments, and API keys and delete the victim account.

title: CVE-2026-126802 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains hardcoded HTTP Basic Auth credentials in ns-admin's AuthAgent and AuthExternal routers that allow unauthenticated attackers to access protected APIs. Attackers can call /agent/config to obtain Redis passwords, etcd details and the server token, and impersonate scan nodes via registration, heartbeat and logging endpoints.

title: CVE-2026-126803 — Rote through 2
summary: Rote through 2.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows authenticated admins to obtain super_admin rights by reading or overwriting JWT signing secrets via /v2/api/admin/settings. Attackers can retrieve the unmasked jwtSecret from the security settings group and forge HS256 tokens for the super administrator to change user roles and escalate their own account.

title: CVE-2026-126804 — WWBN AVideo 12
summary: WWBN AVideo 12.4 through 29.7.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ADs plugin deleteImage.json.php that allows authenticated users with custom ads to delete arbitrary files. Attackers can set the unvalidated is_regular_user parameter to another user's id or ../ sequences to delete other users' ads or files like videos/configuration.php, taking the site offline and re-exposing the installer.

title: CVE-2026-126805 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated Videos Admin users to obtain video_id_hash values bound to any video owner via encoder endpoints like aVideoEncoderStatus.json.php. Attackers can request the hash for an administrator-owned video and replay it through useVideoHashOrLogin() for password-less login, gaining plugin upload, configuration, and user management access.

title: CVE-2026-126806 — WWBN AVideo 14
summary: WWBN AVideo 14.3 through 29.7.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows uploaders to inject scripts via the videoDownloadedLink value stored unescaped through objects/aVideoEncoder.json.php. Attackers can embed event-handler payloads in the URL host rendered as a Source tag in view/managerVideos_body.php, executing in administrator sessions to install plugin archives containing PHP.

title: CVE-2026-126807 — WuzAPI through 1
summary: WuzAPI through 1.1.0 contains a cross-tenant information disclosure vulnerability in the GetHistory handler that allows authenticated users to view other tenants' chat metadata. Attackers with message history enabled can request GET /chat/history with chat_jid=index to list every user's internal ID, stored chat JIDs, and last-message times.

title: CVE-2026-126808 — weDevs ERP (WP ERP) through 1
summary: weDevs ERP (WP ERP) through 1.17.11 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to edit their own HR records because HRM AJAX handlers check erp_edit_employee instead of erp_manage_jobinfo. Attackers can post their own user_id with the My Profile nonce to change designation, reporting manager, pay rate, and employment type, or delete job history.

title: CVE-2026-126809 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in objects/import.json.php that allows uploaders to import other users' MP4 files by referencing any folder under videos/. Attackers can copy private, unlisted, password-protected or pay-per-view videos, read victims' .txt/.html sidecars as descriptions, list files via objects/listFiles.json.php, and delete victims' media using the delete parameter.

title: CVE-2026-126810 — WWBN AVideo 29
summary: WWBN AVideo 29.1.0 through 29.7.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject markup through the channel About field rendered in feed/index.php. Attackers can store an unquoted event-handler payload that bypasses feedHtmlDescription() filtering and executes via rss-style.xsl for any visitor, including administrators, viewing the channel feed.

title: CVE-2026-126811 — BookStack before 26
summary: BookStack before 26.09.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' unpublished draft page images by checking only PageView permission without draft status. Attackers can read drawio data via the base64 endpoint or rename, replace, or delete draft images by sequential ID to disclose or tamper with unpublished work.

title: CVE-2026-126812 — blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4

Unauthenticated attackers reaching the Docker host on port 3306 can log in as root without a password to read, modify, or delete user accounts, blueprints, and all databases.

title: CVE-2026-126813 — Roundcube Webmail before 1

Attackers can lure logged-in victims into opening crafted GET links to mail/show or mail/get, executing IMAP commands that delete messages, change flags, or grant mailbox access via SETACL.

title: CVE-2026-126814 — blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4

Attackers can set a blueprint video URL on an attacker-controlled host, which site.js loads in an unsandboxed iframe after consent, framing fake login forms or malware downloads.

title: CVE-2026-65957 — Helio is an MCP proxy that sits between AI agents and the tools they use
summary: Helio is an MCP proxy that sits between AI agents and the tools they use. A public DNS name such as 192.168.attacker.com, 10.evil.io, or 172.16.pwn.example also satisfies that prefix, so the proxy echoed the attacker origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. This issue has been patched in version 0.8.0.

title: Britain, France set out first guidelines for commercial hacking firms
summary: The guidelines call on businesses that develop, sell or finance CCICs to vet their customers, establish technical safeguards against misuse and to maintain systems for monitoring and reporting abuses.

title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.

title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.

title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.

title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.

title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle "Rey," was detained as ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting a business unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing, which manufactures the fleet of planes used by the employer of Rey's father -- Royal Jordanian Airlines.

title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.

title: Microsoft Patches 1,259 Flaws, Including Exploited Outlook Bug That May Expose NTLMv2 Hashes
summary: Microsoft on Tuesday released patches for a total of 1,259 vulnerabilities spanning its software portfolio, the second consecutive month where the patch volume has exceeded 1,000 flaws. title: CVE-2026-116468 — A flaw was found in the group-move and organization group reparenting endpoints of the keycloak-services component
summary: A flaw was found in the group-move and organization group reparenting endpoints of the keycloak-services component. This component is responsible for core authentication and authorization services in the Red Hat build of Keycloak. The issue occurs because the system fails to check if a target parent group confers administrative roles when a group is moved. A delegated administrator can exploit this to move a group they control under an administrative group, causing all members to inherit full realm-admin privileges and gain complete control over the realm.

summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox. title: CVE-2026-124738 — A flaw was found in BusyBox
summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When the HTTP daemon (httpd) has pre-compressed file support enabled, authentication checks are evaluated only against the requested URL path rather than the pre-compressed file being served. A remote attacker can exploit this flaw by requesting an uncompressed file path while specifying gzip encoding, bypassing password rules configured specifically for the compressed file. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized information disclosure of sensitive files.

title: CVE-2026-124740 — A flaw was found in BusyBox's udhcpc6 DHCPv6 client
summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox's udhcpc6 DHCPv6 client. A malicious server on the local network can trigger a use-after-free condition by responding with a crafted Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6) reply packet lacking usable address options. This issue causes the client to read stale heap memory, which can result in a Denial of Service (DoS) due to an application crash or disclose previously assigned network address data in subsequent discovery requests.

title: CVE-2026-124742 — A flaw was found in BusyBox
summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox. The volume identification component fails to properly validate cluster parameters when analyzing specially formatted FAT filesystems. An attacker able to present a crafted storage device or disk image can trigger a divide-by-zero condition when partition scanning utilities inspect the volume. This issue causes the probing utilities to crash unexpectedly, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) that can disrupt device discovery and system boot operations.

title: CVE-2026-124743 — A flaw was found in BusyBox
summary: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When processing filesystem metadata, the volume identification component does not properly validate header values in HFS+ filesystems. An attacker able to attach a storage device or supply a specially crafted filesystem image can trigger an application crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) and preventing device resolution.

summary: A flaw was found in the login-failure storage component of Keycloak, the identity and access management solution. This issue specifically affects deployments using MySQL or MariaDB databases in a multi-node configuration. When multiple failed login attempts occur simultaneously for the same account, a synchronization error can cause the system to enter a repetitive loop that locks the user's record in the database. title: CVE-2026-118405 — Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4
summary: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to learn other users' email addresses. The user search in the authoring interface shows only user names, but it also matched the search text against email addresses, so a user could confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which matches only user names for users who are not administrators.

title: CVE-2026-118408 — Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 4
summary: Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to read unpublished entries of a weblog they have no role in. The entry preview checked that the user was logged in, but not that the user had a role in the weblog being previewed. The attacker must know the weblog name and the entry's link name. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires a role in the weblog to preview its entries.

title: CVE-2026-118409 — Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4
summary: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to recover the email addresses of people who left approved comments. The search index stored commenter email addresses, and the public weblog search accepted queries on that field, including wildcard queries that confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later and rebuild the search index.

title: CVE-2026-118410 — Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere in Apache Roller 4
summary: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to read an entry after its author has withdrawn it to draft through the AtomPub API. The entry was removed from the weblog but stayed in the search index, and public search showed its content. AtomPub is disabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which shows only published entries in search results.

title: CVE-2026-118411 — Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Apache Roller 5
summary: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Apache Roller 5.0.1 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated attacker to create an administrator account if a logged-in Roller administrator opens a link that the attacker controls. The request-token check applied only to POST requests, and administrative actions also accepted GET requests. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires POST and a valid token for actions that change data.

title: CVE-2026-118412 — Improper Authentication in Apache Roller 5
summary: Improper Authentication in Apache Roller 5.1.0 through 6.1.6 allows a user whose account an administrator has disabled to sign in again through OpenID and read unpublished entries. The OpenID sign-in path did not check whether the account was enabled. Only sites that enable the non-default OpenID authentication mode are affected; later major versions do not include OpenID 2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

title: CVE-2026-118413 — Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 4
summary: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's visitors. Blogroll links imported from an OPML file were not checked, and the default theme printed them without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which accepts only web links on import and escapes them on output.

title: CVE-2026-118414 — Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 6
summary: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 6.1.2 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's members when they open their main menu. The HTML-stripping routine kept a tag that was not closed, and the main menu printed the weblog description without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

summary: MQTTX desktop through 1.13.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by publishing malicious MQTT topic names or payloads rendered unescaped in tooltips. Attackers controlling a broker or publishing to subscribed topics can execute script in the Electron renderer, which has nodeIntegration enabled, when victims hover Topic Tree or JSON tree nodes.

title: CVE-2026-126496 — 1Panel-dev CordysCRM before 1
summary: 1Panel-dev CordysCRM before 1.9.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CustomerContactController.get that allows authenticated users to read other users' contacts because no organization, owner or data-scope check is applied. Attackers holding ordinary contact or customer read permission can request GET /account/contact/get/{id} with another contact's ID to obtain names, phone numbers, owners, departments, linked customers and custom fields.

title: CVE-2026-126497 — LibreCAD through 2
summary: LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the bundled libdxfrw dwgReader18::parseDataPage() function due to unchecked buffer size and page offsets. Attackers can craft an AC1018 (R2004) DWG file with malicious startOffset values that cause decompress18 to write past the heap buffer when opened, causing crashes and potential code execution.

title: CVE-2026-126498 — WriteFreely before 0
summary: WriteFreely before 0.17.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated authors to inject HTML by supplying a malicious post slug via the CreatePost API. The raw slug is concatenated into an anchor by augmentReadingDestination() for paid-shortcode posts, executing script for RSS/Atom feed readers, newsletter recipients and ActivityPub viewers.

title: CVE-2026-126499 — Jellyfin before 12
summary: Jellyfin before 12.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DELETE /Library/VirtualFolders and POST /Library/VirtualFolders/Name endpoints that allows attackers to delete or move directories via unvalidated library names. Unauthenticated attackers can supply names like .. or absolute paths before setup completes to recursively delete the data directory and jellyfin.db.

title: CVE-2026-126539 — Directus before 12
summary: Directus before 12.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip permission checks by sending a failed auth message on public-mode WebSocket connections. Attackers can send an invalid token so handleAuthRequest sets accountability to null, then read, create, update or delete records in any user-defined collection.

title: CVE-2026-126541 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Live plugin restream endpoints that allows authenticated streamers to obtain other users' stream keys by supplying arbitrary live_transmitions_history_id values. Attackers can redeem the issued action tokens at verifyTokenForAction.json.php to retrieve victims' HLS URLs and stream keys, then publish as the victim or restream private or pay-per-view lives.

title: CVE-2026-126542 — WWBN AVideo 6
summary: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user via Hybridauth social login display names. Attackers can set their X, Facebook, Yahoo or LinkedIn display name to a victim's username and withhold email, causing login.json.php or oauth2.php to log them in as that account, including administrators, without a password.

title: CVE-2026-126543 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an improper payment verification vulnerability in plugin/PayPalYPT/ipnV2.php that credits wallets from PayPal IPNs not bound to the site's merchant account. Unauthenticated attackers can forward genuine VERIFIED recurring-payment IPNs from their own PayPal account with a chosen users_id to add wallet balance each billing cycle.

title: CVE-2026-126544 — WWBN AVideo 6
summary: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an email verification bypass vulnerability in User::verifyCode() in objects/user.php caused by PHP loose comparison of the recoverPass token. Registered users can reuse the installation-wide salt from their own verification link and craft a code with arbitrary users_id and recoverPass set to true to verify other accounts' emails, unlocking features such as live streaming.

title: CVE-2026-126545 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in API::get_api_tags() in plugin/API/API.php that allows registered users to access restricted video data by querying the tags API. Attackers can subscribe to a tag and query APIName=tags to obtain filenames, titles and stored video_password values of unlisted, group-restricted and password-protected videos, enabling unauthorized viewing.

title: CVE-2026-126546 — Viber for iOS through 29
summary: Viber for iOS through 29.4.0.24 fails to validate the logical screen width and height in received GIF headers, allowing attackers to crash the app. Attackers can send a crafted GIF with zero dimensions that triggers an uncaught NSInternalInconsistencyException, aborting the app with SIGABRT when opened.

Attackers can save FACETEDSEARCH_PROFILE_SCHEMA profile keys or labels that break out of option elements, executing scripts for every Special:FacetedSearch visitor including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-126560 — Semantic MediaWiki 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DataTables integration that initialises author-written smw-datatable tables unchanged. Users with page-edit rights can add HTML entity-encoded markup in data-search or data-filter cell attributes, executing script in viewers' browsers including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-126561 — Semantic MediaWiki 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows editors without the edit-protection right to lock pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. Attackers can add [[Is edit protected::true]] to pages or #set it in widely transcluded templates, so the TitleQuickPermissions hook blocks other editors and administrators from editing, moving or deleting them indefinitely.

title: CVE-2026-126562 — Semantic MediaWiki 3
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the ElasticStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter that only detects directly self-referencing concepts. title: CVE-2026-126563 — Semantic MediaWiki 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 2.4.0 before 7.4.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in TimeValueFormatter::getCaptionFromFreeFormat(), which emits free-format date captions in HTML without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a Special:Ask URL with HTML markup in a date printout format (#-F[...]) to execute script in a logged-in victim's browser session.

title: CVE-2026-126564 — Semantic MediaWiki 2
summary: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ValueFormatter::getFormattedSubject() that renders property label segments after a literal   as unescaped markup. Users with page-edit rights can set a preferred property label containing an img onerror payload that executes when anyone, including administrators, views Special:Browse or the smwbrowse API.

summary: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the ElasticStore and SPARQLStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter classes, which re-expand concepts without memoization or an expansion budget. Users with page-edit rights can build acyclic chains of Concept: pages that fan out, so queries via concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask exhaust CPU and memory.

title: CVE-2026-126567 — Semantic MediaWiki 3
